annotations.title: Run a script on a scene

description:
Run one GDScript func run(ctx) in the live editor on the scene at scenePath: the way to make 3 or more scene edits, loops, grids and procedural meshes. Returns reports, output and errors. Loop: summer_world_snapshot, this, summer_snapshot_diff, summer_screenshot.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/run-script"}

checkpoint.description: Take a SummerGit checkpoint before running (default true). The result confesses (no_rewind_point) when no checkpoint could be taken.

max_seconds.description: Time budget in seconds (default 20, clamped 5-120). The script blocks the editor while it runs — keep it short.

scenePath.description: The scene to run against, e.g. 'res://main.tscn'. Opened first when it is not the edited scene, then the person's tab is restored. Omit only to run against whatever scene is open.

source.description: GDScript source containing `func run(ctx):`. No extends/@tool line — just the function (plus any helpers).

undo.description: Transaction mode (newer engines). 'action' (engine default): the whole run is ONE named undo action, and a mid-script runtime error rolls it back before returning (result rolled_back:true) — no…
